summaries.html:
Empowering Moms Act

This bill provides statutory authority for moms.gov, a Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) website providing pregnant and postpartum women and women parenting young children with information on health- and family-related services, opportunities for assistance, and other support. HHS must update the website with location-specific search functions and provide grants to states for coordinating the identification of relevant resources. The bill prohibits the website from including resources offered by certain nonprofits that provide abortions.
